content_sections.heading: About KEA Female Supervisor
content_sections.text: The Karnataka Examinations Authority, Bengaluru, a body of the Government of Karnataka, conducts this recruitment for the Women and Child Development Department. The posts are the 25 percent share of Female Supervisor direct-recruitment vacancies in the department's Kalyana Karnataka cadre. Under the cadre and recruitment rules, this share is filled through "Direct Recruitment (General) and in services as per clause (i)".

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 30 Female Supervisor posts in the pay scale Rs. 44425-83700. Under the department's cadre and recruitment rules, Female Supervisor posts are reserved for women. Only women candidates should apply. The 2 in-service posts are reserved for women staff of the Women and Child Development Department who hold a pay scale lower than that of Female Supervisor. Only eligible in-service women should apply for them. If eligible in-service women are not available, these posts will be filled by Direct Recruitment (General) candidates. The post-wise and category-wise break-up is published separately, as given by the Women and Child Development Department. It may be revised if the department revises it.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: For Direct Recruitment (General) and in services as per clause (i): a Bachelor Degree in Home Science or Social Work or Home Science or Sociology or B.Sc. (Home Science/Community Science). Candidates who have taken the qualifying examination and are awaiting results on the last date for applications are not eligible. No qualification other than the one above will be considered. All candidates must hold the degree marks card or certificate by the last date for applications. Original marks cards and certificates must be produced at document verification. Otherwise, the candidature will be cancelled. If a candidate without the prescribed qualification is found at any stage, her candidature will be cancelled without notice. Must be a citizen of India. A woman married to a man who has another living wife is not eligible without prior permission from the Government. Must be mentally and physically healthy and free from any physical defect likely to interfere with her duties. The State Government may reject a candidate on the basis of a medical board report. Persons permanently debarred by UPSC, KPSC, any other State Public Service Commission or KEA are not eligible. A person convicted of an offence involving moral turpitude, or temporarily debarred or disqualified by these bodies, is not eligible until the Government reviews her case and considers her eligible. Under the Karnataka Civil Services (General Recruitment) Rules, 1977, applicants must have completed 18 years as on the last date fixed for submitting applications. Under Government Order No. ಸಿಆಸುಇ 262 ಸೇನೆನಿ 2025 dated 29.01.2026, a one-time relaxation of 5 years applies to the maximum age. The upper limits below already include it: Under the same Rules, the maximum age is raised further in the following cases: Family members of armed forces personnel who died or were permanently disabled in service can claim ex-servicemen reservation, but they do not get the age relaxation. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through a competitive examination of two papers, held online (CBT) or in Offline-OMR mode. Candidates who are not exempt must also qualify in the compulsory Kannada Language Examination. Paper-1 covers the following topics: Current events, general science, geography and social science. History of Indian society and its development; history of India and Karnataka; the Indian Constitution and public administration. Practical knowledge and mental ability (SSLC level). Social and cultural history of Karnataka, and land reforms and social change in Karnataka after independence. Karnataka's economy, its strengths and weaknesses; rural development, Panchayat Raj institutions and rural co-operative institutions. The role of science and technology in effective governance in Karnataka; environmental problems and development of Karnataka; mental ability. Rules for the competitive examination: A minimum of 35 percent marks in the competitive examination is compulsory to qualify. Each question has 4 options. 0.25 mark is deducted for each wrong answer. The OMR sheet has a 5th option for unanswered questions. Five extra minutes are given after the final bell to shade it. If no option is shaded for a question, 0.25 mark is deducted. The Kannada Language Examination is a multiple-choice paper of 150 marks, set to the standard of SSLC first-language Kannada. The minimum qualifying mark is 50. Candidates who are absent or score less than 50 are not eligible for selection. The marks are not counted for selection or seniority. The following candidates are exempt from this examination: Those who studied Kannada as a first or second language in the SSLC examination of the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board, or in an equivalent or higher examination. Those who passed such examinations in the Kannada medium. Those who passed the compulsory Kannada examination held earlier by the Commission or another selection authority. Sports achievers will be given weightage marks as specified in Government Notification No. ಸಿಆಸುಇ 295 ಸೇನೆನಿ 2023.

faq.question: Q1. How many Female Supervisor posts has KEA announced?
faq.answer: KEA has announced 30 Female Supervisor posts: 28 for Direct Recruitment (General) and 2 for in-service women employees of the Women and Child Development Department.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for KEA Female Supervisor 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 28 November 2026, and the fee can be paid until 29 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Can men apply for the KEA Female Supervisor posts?
faq.answer: No. The posts are reserved for women under the department's cadre and recruitment rules, and only women candidates should apply.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for KEA Female Supervisor?
faq.answer: Applicants need a Bachelor Degree in Home Science or Social Work or Sociology, or a B.Sc. (Home Science/Community Science). The degree must be held by the last date for applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for KEA Female Supervisor?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years, counted as on the last date for applications. The maximum age is 40 years for General Merit, 43 years for Category 2A, 2B, 3A and 3B, and 45 years for SC, ST and Category-1. These limits include a one-time 5-year relaxation.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 750/- for General Merit and Category 2A, 2B, 3A and 3B, and Rs. 500/- for SC, ST, Category-1, ex-servicemen and third gender. Persons with disabilities pay Rs. 250/-. The fee is paid online only and is not refundable.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of a KEA Female Supervisor?
faq.answer: The pay scale is Rs. 44425-83700. The National Pension Scheme applies, and there is a probation period of two years.

faq.question: Q8. Is there negative marking in the KEA Female Supervisor exam?
faq.answer: Yes. 0.25 mark is deducted for each wrong answer, and also for any OMR question where no option is shaded. A minimum of 35 percent marks is needed to qualify.

faq.question: Q9. When is the Kannada Language Examination?
faq.answer: The Kannada Language Examination is on 8 January 2027, from 3.00 PM to 5.00 PM. The dates of Paper-1 and Paper-2 will be announced later.
